layers.label: League results, current season
layers.note: Football-Data is primary for results and team match stats. API-Football is the fallback for a current-season result football-data has not published yet; it fills every SPFL tier, while the official SPFL club feed still wins for Aberdeen. The provider result is never used to override an existing football-data score: a disagreement is recorded. API-Football does not currently supply all-tier team match stats, so the result fallback is kept separate from the stats source.
layers.scope: current season, all four SPFL tiers

layers.label: League results, historical
layers.note: Historical league results and the compact pre-2019 baseline.
layers.scope: 2013-14 to the season before the current one

layers.label: League team match stats
layers.note: Shots, corners, fouls and cards for the style/theme proxies. API-Football team statistics are not available for every SPFL tier.

layers.label: League tables
layers.note: Computed from league results with split and deduction rules.

layers.label: League Cup and Scottish Cup fixtures
layers.note: League Cup is complete; Scottish Cup is 50 of 136 ties at the key-test. Missing rounds are labelled.

layers.label: Aberdeen club fixture list
layers.note: The SPFL club feed supplies the short horizon; the normalized API-Football season schedule supplies the remaining fixtures. Rows are merged and conflicts are labelled; /matches/ keeps the played record plus scheduled rows without pages.

layers.label: Lineups, formations and starting roles
layers.note: Roles are derived from the starting-XI grid, never from position labels.

layers.label: Player match ratings and stats
layers.note: Premiership coverage; lower-tier current-season player stats were empty at the key-test. Historical player-match-stat files are empty.

layers.label: Named matchday squads
layers.note: Every starter and named substitute from the cached lineup response, including unused substitutes. Bench completeness is published per side and gates omission inference; a missing bench is unknown, not empty.

layers.label: Scouting league tables for team context
layers.note: One standings request per enabled league. The group with the most played rounds is used; a league without a table is unknown, never zero-strength. The team points percentile is within the league only.
layers.scope: current table for every enabled scouting league

layers.label: Current club resolution for the scouting pool
layers.note: The stats row names the club where the season statistics were produced. The current club comes from the latest recorded transfer on or before the snapshot date. A player with no later transfer keeps the stats club with source stats_snapshot. A subsequent move that does not involve a pool team may be missing, so the page labels the source.
layers.scope: transfer feed for every team represented in the scouting pool

layers.label: European league-phase player appearances
layers.note: League-phase fixtures only; qualifiers and play-offs are excluded. The season /players endpoint mixes rounds, so the flag comes from the per-fixture player endpoint. A player not found is unknown unless the run is complete; unknown is never discounted.
layers.scope: 2026-27 league phases of the Champions League, Europa League and Conference League

layers.label: Scouting player pool and starting-XI roles
layers.note: Season player statistics and starting-XI lineups for the configured scouting universe. Seven enabled leagues return no player season statistics, and several leagues omit the formation and grid. Coverage is labelled per league; nothing is zero-filled or inferred.

layers.label: Event-derived Aberdeen stats
layers.note: Reconstructed from lineups and events; not tracking data.
layers.scope: Aberdeen fixtures with lineups and events

layers.label: Official squad roster
layers.note: The official AFC men's team page is canonical for inclusion, position section, shirt number and the On loan section. It does not label injuries; no injury is inferred. API-Football remains the statistics and identity spine. API rows outside the official list are retained only for existing player links and are not squad players.
layers.scope: current men's team, one listed page per refresh

layers.label: Current squad identity and statistics
layers.note: Curated player overrides correct identity or youth gaps; the official roster layer owns roster inclusion and loan-section status.

layers.label: Preferred foot
layers.note: Sportmonks is gated; AFC official yields no foot values today; Wikipedia is last resort with a revision permalink. One value is known; every other player is unknown rather than inferred.

layers.label: Transfer candidate feed
layers.note: Candidate feed only; it has no fees, loan end dates or recall terms.

layers.label: Published transfer register
layers.note: Curated against AFC announcements and Wikipedia season records, with the API-Football candidate feed as discovery. Most rows are curated, not provider-confirmed; fees are mostly undisclosed.

layers.label: Loan register
layers.note: Loan-out tags come from the register; end/recall/obligation terms are unknown.

layers.label: Broadcast and streaming listings
layers.note: Curated from official club and SPFL pages. Broadcaster schedules are not scraped, no price or stream is published, and an absent listing is not a claim that a match is not televised.

layers.label: AFC news headlines
layers.note: Listing metadata only; article bodies are not copied.

layers.label: Injuries and availability
layers.note: Curated official AFC team news is primary. API-Football /injuries is an optional provider snapshot; its current-season Scottish coverage is reported false. Provider 'injured' booleans are not team news.

layers.label: Curated rumour register
layers.note: Unconfirmed links, separate from the confirmed register.

layers.label: Fan signal
layers.note: Sampled, rule-based, no raw posts or usernames.

layers.label: Cormack-era historical record
layers.note: Mixed sources: API-Football backfill, football-data style proxies, AFC official and Wikipedia curation. The season documents label their basis.

layers.label: Inferred transfer values
layers.note: Disclosed/reported anchors plus a transparent age/position/market model.

layers.label: Former-player record
layers.note: Derived from the confirmed transfer register, the covered Aberdeen history and licensed API-Football player seasons. Post-career league rows are measured where covered; missing seasons and curated-only identities are explicit gaps.

layers.label: Sell-on event evidence
layers.note: A subsequent transfer is detected from the provider history; a receipt is computed only when the clause percentage, basis and every required public fee are evidenced. Missing inputs are published, never inferred.

layers.label: Medium and long-term themes
layers.note: Derived from lineups, events, provider ratings, league rows and history.

layers.label: Squad needs
layers.note: Derived from themes, availability, squad minutes, transfers and rumours. Role profiles only; no targets or invented fees.

layers.label: fitba expected goals
layers.note: The fxG model is derived from licensed shot and match features. It is descriptive; the provider-xG evaluation gate is failing, so it is not a confidence verdict or tracking data.
layers.scope: current-season league matches with shot-zone inputs

layers.label: Betting odds
layers.note: Not ingested or published.
